shellCommands.command: ls -la && git ls-files && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; head -c 600 package-lock.json
cat .gitignore index.html src/*.ts* tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -o '"display-[0-9]"\|"header-[0-9]"\|"subheader-[0-9]"\|"body-[0-9]"' build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; ls build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; sed -n 1,80p build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts; cat build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -60
grep -n "as?\|color?\|variant?" build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head; grep -n "view\|type" build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -i 's/<html lang="en">/<html lang="ru">/; s|<title>Gravity UI eval</title>|<title>Часомер — учёт времени для команд</title>|' index.html && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15
